external_validation: The paper reports an independent 30% validation cohort (n=39) created by a 7:3 random split of the same recruited sample; this is not validation in a separately recruited external population.
ground_truth_method: Structured face-to-face retrospective interview of whether the participant experienced at least one fall while residing in the nursing home during the preceding 12 months; binary >=1 fall versus none.
notes: Volume/article: 26, 554. The studied population was a relatively high-functioning ambulatory institutional subgroup able to walk independently without assistive devices. The authors caution against generalizing the results to residents with advanced frailty, assistive-device dependence, or severe functional impairment.
population: Ambulatory nursing-home residents aged >=80 years from four long-term-care institutions in Shanghai, China
title: Validation of World Guideline gait speed and TUG cut-offs for fall risk stratification in ambulatory nursing home residents aged ≥ 80 years: a multicenter cross-sectional diagnostic study
